_meta.title: @agent-ui/data v1 — DataSource seam + signal-backed resource/mutation + gateway client + unified streaming (design + build decomposition)
_meta.author: planner (design seat)
_meta.grounding: Kim's 2026-08-16 ruling on GH #955/#956/#957 (`.claude/ops/rulings.md` §'Placement forks + ADR harvest — RULED 2026-08-16'): mint `@agent-ui/data` as a zero-dep sibling off `components` (router/code precedent, ADR-0115/ADR-0119), #957 folds into #956, ONE PRD/SPEC covers all three, the package mint rides a proposed ADR. Upstream seams (brief `.claude/docs/briefs/saas-utilities.brief.md` §0): `AgentTransport`/`AgentProvider` (a2ui `src/agent/agent-transport.ts`, ADR-0137 — cited precedent, NOT re-drawn: brief fork 2 resolved 'cited precedent') · `readNdjsonLines` (`site/lib/ndjson-lines.ts` — hoisted, not duplicated) · `A2aChannel` (a2a `src/channel/loopback.ts`) · signals kernel (`components/src/reactive/`) · corpus store single-writer `put` (ADR-0062) · a2ui structural-sharing `setPointer` + Object.is cutoff · `SettingsStore` (app `settings/store.ts`, SPEC-R12) · the #959 StorageAdapter seam in `@agent-ui/shared` (ruled 2026-08-16 — persistence is that seam's, NOT this package's; v1 names the convergence and fences it) · ADR-0191 (`:state(pending)` — the visual convention a resource's stale/pending state feeds; the data layer never restyles). Non-goals (PRD §4): no UI controls · no a2ui coupling · no server code · no persistence adapter · no local-first sync.
_meta.outside_in: system `@agent-ui/data` → subsystems {package boundary, core `.`, `./gateway`, `./stream`, gates+teaching, design records} → modules (one file each) → units.
_meta.inside_out: capabilities enumerated from the three issues' Acceptance rows + the brief's P2/P3/P4/P5/P7 canon, derived BEFORE the structure was cut so they can contradict it; each mapped to exactly one hosting module.
_meta.modes: plan=true (every leaf carries an accept predicate) · checked with --strict (advisories blocking).

nodes.label: package boundary — packages/agent-ui/data/{package.json, tsconfig, src/index.ts, src/layering.test.ts}
nodes.accept: `data/src/layering.test.ts` green: every import under data/src resolves to {@agent-ui/components, @agent-ui/shared} or a local path AND no source under components/src, a2ui/src, shared/src, router/src, code/src imports @agent-ui/data; goes RED under a planted upward/inward import (negative control, unique token); `npm run check` exits 0

nodes.label: core `.` barrel — the data seam
src/core/data-source.ts — `DataSource<T,K>` strategy interface: `read`/`list`/`create`/`update`/`remove`/`subscribe` all OPTIONAL capabilities
nodes.accept: type test: a `{ read }`-only object satisfies `DataSource`; `resource()` over a source lacking `subscribe` compiles and runs; adding a new optional verb leaves every fixture source byte-unchanged (SPEC-R2 AC)

nodes.label: src/core/resource.ts — `resource(key, source, opts?)` → `{ status, data, error, updatedAt, pending, refetch, dispose }` (signals)
nodes.accept: jsdom suite: idle→loading→success/error transitions; SWR (cached value served synchronously, background revalidate); dedup (two resources same key → ONE source call); abort on dispose/supersede (`AbortSignal.aborted` true on the superseded call); no DOM global referenced (headless gate RED on planted `window`)

nodes.label: src/core/mutation.ts — `mutation(fn, { invalidate?, optimistic? })` → `{ status, error, run }` with declared cache effects
nodes.accept: jsdom suite: `run` transitions idle→pending→success/error; `invalidate` keys refetch on settle; optimistic: snapshot → local patch visible synchronously → rollback restores the snapshot byte-equal on error (structural-sharing: untouched siblings keep identity, Object.is)

nodes.label: src/core/cache.ts — key registry + structural-sharing store (single-writer `commit`, `snapshot`, `invalidate(key|prefix)`)
nodes.accept: unit suite: single-writer (only `commit` mutates; a direct write on a snapshot does not wake subscribers); `invalidate('users/')` marks every `users/*` entry stale; snapshot/restore round-trip byte-equal

nodes.label: src/core/error.ts — `DataError` envelope `{ kind: 'http'|'network'|'abort'|'parse'|'unknown', status?, code?, retryable, cause }` + `normalizeError(unknown): DataError`
nodes.accept: unit suite: a `TypeError` from fetch → `network`/retryable; `DOMException AbortError` → `abort`/not retryable; `Response 503` → `http`/retryable; `Response 404` → `http`/not retryable; `SyntaxError` on JSON → `parse`; already-`DataError` passes through by identity

nodes.label: src/core/paginated.ts — `paginated(key, source, { getNextCursor })` thin layer over resource: pages list, `loadMore`, refetch-from-first on invalidate
nodes.accept: jsdom suite: `pages` grows by one per `loadMore`; `hasMore` false when `getNextCursor` returns undefined; invalidate → refetch from the first cursor, pages replaced not appended

nodes.label: `./gateway` subpath — the consumer-side client contract (P7)
src/gateway/client.ts — `createGateway({ baseUrl?, fetch?, middleware[] })`: onion `(req, next) => Promise<Response>`, request shaping (base URL, headers, JSON serialization)
nodes.accept: unit suite with a stubbed fetch: middleware order is onion (outer sees the response last); base URL + default headers applied; a middleware that throws surfaces as `DataError`; zero references to DOM globals

nodes.label: src/gateway/auth.ts — `withToken(getToken)` decorator + single-flight 401 refresh (`refresh?` hook; one refresh in flight; queued requests replay once)
nodes.accept: unit suite: N concurrent 401s → exactly ONE `refresh()` call, N replays with the new token; the token never lands in cache/state (grep + a `snapshot()` assertion); a failed refresh rejects every queued request with the SAME `DataError` (kind `http`, status 401, retryable false)

nodes.label: src/gateway/retry.ts — `withRetry({ maxAttempts, baseMs, capMs, retryOn? })`: exp backoff + full jitter, idempotent/`retryable`-only, honors `Retry-After` (seconds + HTTP-date), `AbortSignal`-interruptible
nodes.accept: unit suite with fake timers: 503,503,200 → 3 attempts and delays within [0, base·2^n] (jitter); a POST without `idempotent: true` retries ZERO times; `Retry-After: 2` → ≥2000 ms wait; abort mid-backoff rejects with `kind: 'abort'` immediately; attempts capped

nodes.label: src/gateway/passthrough (a RULE + gate, not a module): middleware MUST NOT read/tee/buffer `Response.body`; streaming responses pass through untouched
nodes.accept: test: a streaming stub `Response` passed through the full default middleware chain reaches the caller with `body.locked === false` and `bodyUsed === false`; a planted `await res.text()` in a middleware reds the gate (negative control)

nodes.label: `./stream` subpath — the ONE `Streamed<T>` contract + three adapters (P2)

src/stream/bridge.ts — `Streamed<T> = AsyncIterable<T>`; `pushToPull<T>({ backpressure: 'buffer'|'drop-oldest'|'drop-newest', highWaterMark })` push-queue → async iterator; `return()`/`AbortSignal` teardown hook
nodes.accept: unit suite: 'buffer' keeps every pushed item; 'drop-oldest'/'drop-newest' at highWaterMark drop the declared side; `iterator.return()` and `signal.abort()` each invoke the teardown hook exactly once and end the iterator; a push after end is a no-op

nodes.label: src/stream/from-fetch-stream.ts — `fromFetchStream(input, init & { frame: 'ndjson'|'sse'|'lines' })` over `fetch` + `ReadableStream` (POST-capable, header-capable); `readNdjsonLines` HOISTED here (site/lib becomes a re-export shim)
nodes.accept: the existing `site/lib/ndjson-lines.test.ts` chunk-boundary cases pass against the hoisted implementation; `site/lib/ndjson-lines.ts` is a re-export (grep: no second implementation body); SSE frame parse: multi-line `data:` joined, `event:`/`id:` surfaced, comments ignored; abort → `reader.cancel()` called (spy)

nodes.label: src/stream/from-event-source.ts — `fromEventSource(url, { events?, withCredentials? })`; documents the no-custom-headers auth constraint (cookie/query/ticket); `Last-Event-ID` resume is the platform's
nodes.accept: browser shard: a stubbed EventSource yields typed events through the bridge; `return()` calls `es.close()`; the README/doc block states the header constraint (grep the doc string)

nodes.label: src/stream/from-web-socket.ts — `fromWebSocket(url, { heartbeat?, reconnect?, highWaterMark? })`: bidirectional (`send`), heartbeat ping/timeout, exp-backoff reconnect (opt-in), `bufferedAmount` backpressure signal
nodes.accept: unit suite with a fake WebSocket: messages yield in order; `return()` closes with code 1000; heartbeat timeout triggers reconnect when opted in (fake timers, count = 1); `send` past `highWaterMark` awaits drain; no reconnect after an explicit `return()`

nodes.label: gates + teaching — tree-shake probe, size line-item, CLAUDE.md Layout/DAG rows, site doc page
nodes.accept: core-only consumer tree-shake probe: no `./gateway`/`./stream` symbols in output; `scripts/measure-size.mjs` carries a `@agent-ui/data` line-item within the SPEC-stated budget; CLAUDE.md Layout + import-DAG rows name `data`; a2ui/router/code/app layering tests extended with the `data` inward-scan; site page + nav/toc gates green; `npm run check && npm test` exit 0

actions.label: declare a data source that supports ONLY the verbs it has (read/list/create/update/remove/subscribe), extra verbs additive-optional
read a keyed resource and bind status/data/error/updatedAt to UI as signals with zero data logic in the component
stale-while-revalidate: serve the cached value synchronously, revalidate in the background
dedupe concurrent reads of the same key into one in-flight source call
invalidate by key or key prefix → every active resource under it refetches
abort an in-flight read on dispose or supersede (AbortSignal reaches the source)
run a mutation with lifecycle signals (idle/pending/success/error)
declare cache effects on a mutation: invalidate keys on settle
optimistic write: snapshot → apply local patch → rollback on error, cheap via structural sharing
paginate by cursor: pages under one key, append on loadMore, refetch-from-first on invalidate
normalize ANY failure into one typed envelope { kind, status?, code?, retryable, cause }
drive UI error/retry states from `kind`/`retryable` alone (no instanceof on vendor errors)
compose request-shaping middleware around fetch (base URL, headers, JSON) as an onion
attach an async-resolved token to requests; on 401 refresh ONCE (single-flight) and replay queued requests; the token never enters the data layer's state
retry retryable/idempotent requests with exponential backoff + full jitter, honor Retry-After, cap attempts, interruptible by AbortSignal
pass a streaming Response body through the gateway untouched (no middleware buffers)
consume any streaming leg through ONE contract: `Streamed<T> = AsyncIterable<T>`
bridge a push source to pull with a DECLARED backpressure policy (buffer / drop-oldest / drop-newest)
tear down: iterator.return() or AbortSignal closes the underlying reader/EventSource/socket exactly once
stream from fetch (NDJSON lines / SSE frames / raw lines), POST- and header-capable — hoisting readNdjsonLines, not duplicating it
stream from EventSource (GET-only; auth via cookie/query/ticket; platform Last-Event-ID resume)
stream from WebSocket with heartbeat, opt-in reconnect, and bufferedAmount backpressure; send() upstream
a DataSource declares subscribe() returning Streamed<T> so a resource updates live (streaming/sockets are first-class CRUD pathways)
install nothing but the package (zero-dep); components/a2ui/shared/router/code never import it (catalog-invisible by construction); the layering trip-wire bites
a core-only consumer pays zero bytes for ./gateway and ./stream (tree-shake gate); size line-item budgeted
wire ADR-0191's :state(pending) from a resource's pending signal in a consuming control — the data layer exposes the signal, never restyles
a reader finds the why/what of the package (problem, users, goals, non-goals) in one PRD
a builder implements from a testable behavior contract with acceptance criteria per requirement
a future reader finds and cites the package-mint decision + rejected alternatives (fold into components; grow inside a2ui; separate gateway package)
the fleet's docs/teaching name the package (CLAUDE.md Layout + DAG rows, site page)
